title: Accelerated Discovery of Novel Ponatinib Analogs with Improved Properties for the Treatment of Parkinson's Disease.
summary: Naïve Bayes networks jointly prioritized c-Abl potency and reduced hERG liability; synthesized compounds were assayed. Improved assay profiles do not establish cardiac safety or Parkinson disease efficacy.
